answer: Each epoch auctions a fixed 2,000 answer slots: identities submit sealed bids, the top 2,000 win, and every winner's bond burns at the clearing price, the lowest winning bid. A farm chasing a thousand slots bids against itself, so its thousandth slot costs far more than its first, and no haven of cheap keys escapes the market. Each bid must be collateralised by that key's own prior settled reward, so a fresh clone cannot bid until it has honestly earned one — the reef of past work is the only ticket to the summit.
